name: InterContinental San Francisco
insider_take: This luxury tower rises 32 stories above SoMa, where tech innovation meets timeless elegance in the heart of San Francisco's fastest-growing neighborhood.
whats_special: The InterContinental San Francisco occupies floors 6-32 of a striking glass tower, offering some of the city's most dramatic skyline views. Located in the vibrant South of Market (SoMa) district, you're steps from the Moscone Center, Oracle Park (home of the Giants), and the emerging Chase Center entertainment complex. The hotel's Club InterContinental lounge on the 32nd floor provides panoramic vistas of the Bay Bridge and downtown skyline.
pro_tip: Book a Bay Bridge view room on floors 20+ for stunning sunrise views and twinkling city lights at night. The hotel's location puts you within walking distance of both the Financial District and Mission Bay's biotech corridor.
dont_miss: Take the hotel's complimentary Tesla house car service (within 2 miles) to explore nearby attractions. The rooftop bar Luce offers craft cocktails with 360-degree city views, while the ground-floor marketplace connects you to the bustling SoMa streetscape. The nearby San Francisco Museum of Modern Art and Yerba Buena Gardens provide cultural escapes just blocks away.
pros: Prime SOMA location with easy access to Union Square and Financial District
Modern luxury accommodations with panoramic city and bay views
World-class amenities including spa, fitness center, and fine dining
Professional business facilities and executive club access
cons: Urban location with typical city noise levels
